description: Set up the monorepo structure, install all dependencies, configure TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and create the Express backend with SQLite database schema including pre-seeded locations.
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspaces configuration pointing to packages/*
Create pnpm-workspace.yaml listing packages/*
Create packages/shared/package.json and packages/shared/src/types.ts with shared TypeScript interfaces: User, Game, Round, Location, GameMode, Score, GameState, GuessResult
Create packages/shared/tsconfig.json

Create packages/server/package.json with dependencies: express, better-sqlite3, cors, uuid, dotenv, and devDependencies: typescript, @types/express, @types/better-sqlite3, @types/cors, @types/uuid, jest, @types/jest, ts-jest, ts-node, nodemon
Create packages/server/tsconfig.json with strict mode

Create packages/server/src/db/schema.sql with tables: users (id, username, email, xp, level, created_at), locations (id, lat, lng, country, city, region, difficulty, description, panorama_url), games (id, user_id, mode, status, total_score, created_at, completed_at), rounds (id, game_id, location_id, round_number, guess_lat, guess_lng, distance_km, score, time_seconds, created_at), achievements (id, user_id, type, unlocked_at), stats (id, user_id, games_played, total_score, avg_distance, best_score, country_streaks, updated_at)
Create packages/server/src/db/database.ts that initializes SQLite database, runs schema, and provides a singleton connection

Create packages/server/src/data/locations.ts with 100+ pre-seeded real-world locations spread across all continents with lat/lng, country, city/region, difficulty (1-5), and Mapillary image IDs or placeholder panorama URLs
Create packages/server/src/db/seed.ts that inserts pre-seeded locations into the database
Create packages/server/src/index.ts as Express entry point with CORS, JSON parsing, and basic health endpoint

Create packages/server/src/routes/game.ts with endpoints: POST /api/games (create game), GET /api/games/:id (get game state), POST /api/games/:id/guess (submit guess), POST /api/games/:id/next (next round), GET /api/games/:id/results (final results)
Create packages/server/src/routes/locations.ts with endpoint: GET /api/locations/random (get random location for a round with mode/difficulty filtering)
Create packages/server/src/routes/stats.ts with endpoints: GET /api/stats/:userId (player stats), GET /api/leaderboard (top scores)
Create packages/server/src/services/scoring.ts implementing score calculation: base 5000 points minus distance penalty, time bonus, combo multiplier
Create packages/server/src/services/gameManager.ts implementing game logic: create game, get random locations avoiding duplicates, manage rounds, calculate totals
Add scripts to packages/server/package.json: dev (nodemon), build (tsc), start (node dist/index.js), test (jest), seed (ts-node src/db/seed.ts)
Create packages/client using Next.js 14 with App Router: npx create-next-app@14 with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, ESLint, App Router
Add additional client dependencies: framer-motion, leaflet, react-leaflet, @types/leaflet, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge
Configure TailwindCSS in packages/client with dark gaming theme: custom colors (dark backgrounds, neon accents), custom fonts, animations
Create packages/client/src/lib/api.ts with typed API client functions for all backend endpoints
Create root-level scripts in root package.json: dev (concurrently run client and server), build (build both), test (test server)
Create .env.example with PORT=3001, DATABASE_PATH=./data/geoguess.db, CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm install at root succeeds and installs all workspace packages
Running pnpm run build compiles both client and server without errors
The SQLite database is created with correct schema when server starts
Pre-seeded locations cover at least 100 real-world places across 30+ countries
All TypeScript compiles without errors in strict mode
findings: Build succeeds for all 3 packages (shared, server, client). Server tsconfig uses declaration:false to avoid pnpm strict symlink TS2742 errors with express types. Seed produces 119 locations across 88 countries. pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies needed for better-sqlite3 and unrs-resolver native builds. Next.js 14.2.4 builds and generates static pages successfully.
